# llms.txt

UI Construction Library (jilimb0.github.io/UI-Library) — Enterprise Design System

UI Construction Library (jilimb0.github.io/UI-Library) is a high-performance, accessible enterprise Design System and React component library adhering to WAI-ARIA standards and Appllama kinematics.

## Key Features

- **Strict A11y & SSR Compliance**: Fully keyboard navigable with WAI-ARIA roles and SSR guards.
- **Physics-Based Kinematics**: Purposeful, spring-based motion profiles honoring `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Theme Engine**: Semantic design tokens, automatic dark/light mode detection, and zero runtime CSS bloat.
